basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 1 Junior Research Fellow Posts. This recruitment drive offers a great opportunity for candidates looking for research jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website.

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: (a) Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professor) and GATE. (b) The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISE, IISER, NIFER etc.
qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: (a) Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professor) and GATE. (b) The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISE, IISER, NIFER etc. Experience: Excellent understanding of Signal Processing. The project is on the design, implementation and validation of signal processing and/or machine learning algorithms for assistive listening devices.

salary_details.details: Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 48,100/- per month (Consolidated) House Rent Allowance: Rs. 11,100/- per month (if applicable) Duration: 1 year

selection_process: The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST
NIFER etc. BTech/MTech in Electrical Engineering/Electronics & Communication Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering or equivalent Excellent understanding of Signal Processing.
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-07-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is 27th July 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through specific national-level examinations like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 48,100/- per month. Additionally, House Rent Allowance of Rs. 11,100/- per month may be applicable.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: You need to apply online through the official recruitment portal of IIT Gandhinagar. The application link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is a temporary role, typically offered for a specific project duration.
